headline: Oil Plunges on Expectations of US-Iran Dialogue and OPEC+ Decision
summary: Oil futures closed sharply lower amid expectations of dialogue between Iran and the US to resolve the Middle East conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, alongside investors digesting an OPEC+ decision.
why: Crude oil is a critical global energy benchmark and input cost, making supply developments and geopolitical negotiations vital drivers of energy sector equities and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Crude oil futures
impacts.why: Oil futures dropped sharply in response to potential talks over the Strait of Hormuz and OPEC+ policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of diplomatic resolutions easing Middle East supply risks and OPEC+ decisions drove crude oil futures down.
